name: Wing Attacks & Recovery
summary: Warm up your handle with your eyes up, score off the wing with jumpers and layups, then finish with defensive recovery work.

drills.name: Eyes-Up Wall Dribbles
drills.summary: Handle the ball without looking at it by locking your eyes on a target.
steps: Stand 10 feet from a wall and pick one spot on it at head height.
Dribble right hand 20 times, then left hand 20 times, eyes on the spot.
Switch to crossovers, then between-the-legs, 20 each.
Step back 5 feet and repeat the set at game speed.

drills.name: Wing One-Bounce Jumpers
drills.summary: Score off one hard dribble from the wing going either way.
steps: Start on the right wing in triple threat, just inside the arc.
Rip through and take one hard dribble toward the middle, then rise and shoot.
Next rep, take one dribble toward the baseline and shoot.
Get your own rebound, sprint back to the wing and repeat.
Switch to the left wing at the halfway point.

drills.name: Inside-Hand Baseline Layups
drills.summary: Drive the baseline and finish with the hand farther from the defender.
steps: Start on the right wing and drive baseline with your right hand.
Finish with your right hand off the glass, body between the rim and the defender.
Next rep, drive and finish with a reverse layup on the far side of the rim.
Switch to the left wing and finish with your left hand.
Count your makes and try to beat it next round.

drills.name: Beaten-Step Recovery Runs
drills.summary: Practice getting beat, turning, sprinting and getting back in front.
steps: Start in a stance at the elbow facing the baseline.
Slide three times to your right like you are guarding the ball.
Pretend the driver beats you: open your hips, sprint three steps toward the baseline.
Plant, drop back into a stance and slide three more times.
Rest 15 seconds and go the other direction. Repeat for the full time.
